blocks.en: ﻿Once you've reached a relic or data site,
blocks.zh: 到达遗迹站点或数据站点后，

blocks.en: it's time to start breaking open those containers for the valuable loot within.
blocks.zh: 就该撬开那些容器，拿走里面的值钱战利品了。

blocks.en: Approach a container, lock it up and activate the relevant module.
blocks.zh: 接近容器，锁定它，然后启动相应的装备：

blocks.en: A relic analyzer for relic sites or a data analyzer for data sites.
blocks.zh: 遗迹站点用遗迹分析仪，数据站点用数据分析仪。

blocks.en: When you activate a relic or data analyzer the hacking screen will open.
blocks.zh: 启动遗迹分析仪或数据分析仪后，会打开破解界面。

blocks.en: From here, you need to successfully break the lock
blocks.zh: 在这里，你需要成功破解锁定，

blocks.en: in order to open the vault and access the loot within.
blocks.zh: 才能打开保险库，拿到里面的战利品。

blocks.en: But note, failing twice will cause the container to explode,
blocks.zh: 但要注意，失败两次会导致容器爆炸，

blocks.en: taking all of the valuables inside with it.
blocks.zh: 里面所有的值钱货也会一起毁掉。

blocks.en: Your goal is to locate and destroy the System Core,
blocks.zh: 你的目标是找到并摧毁系统核心（System Core），

blocks.en: which is hidden somewhere in the network.
blocks.zh: 它隐藏在网络中的某个地方。

blocks.en: Clicking the explorable blue nodes will allow you to proceed to adjacent nodes,
blocks.zh: 点击可探索的蓝色节点，就能继续前往相邻节点，

blocks.en: however be warned, defensive subsystems will be found scattered
blocks.zh: 但要注意，网络中散布着防御子系统，

blocks.en: throughout the network which will attempt to block your path.
blocks.zh: 它们会试图阻挡你的去路。

blocks.en: You will need to overcome or bypass these security systems in order to reach the core.
blocks.zh: 你需要攻克或绕过这些安全系统才能到达核心。

blocks.en: You may also find utility subsystems, which you can use to get an advantage,
blocks.zh: 你还可能找到辅助子系统，用来获得优势，

blocks.en: as well as data caches which may contain either helpful utilities or dangerous defenses.
blocks.zh: 以及数据缓存，里面可能是有用的辅助工具，也可能是危险的防御系统。

blocks.en: In the lower left hand corner of the window,
blocks.zh: 在窗口左下角，

blocks.en: you will also see two bars for Coherence and Strength.
blocks.zh: 你还会看到连贯性（Coherence）和强度（Strength）两个条。

blocks.en: Coherence can be thought of as your 'health',
blocks.zh: 连贯性可以理解为你的「生命值」，

blocks.en: while strength represents the damage you do when attacking a node.
blocks.zh: 强度则代表你攻击节点时造成的伤害。

blocks.en: As you attack defensive subsystems, or the system core,
blocks.zh: 当你攻击防御子系统或系统核心时，

blocks.en: you will take damage to your coherence
blocks.zh: 你的连贯性会受到伤害，

blocks.en: while damaging the coherence of the node you're attacking.
blocks.zh: 同时你也会削减被攻击节点的连贯性。

blocks.en: If you reduce the coherence of a defensive subsystem to zero, it will disappear.
blocks.zh: 如果把防御子系统的连贯性降到零，它就会消失。

blocks.en: However, if your own coherence falls to zero,
blocks.zh: 但如果你自己的连贯性降到零，

blocks.en: you will fail the hack and be kicked from the network.
blocks.zh: 破解就会失败，你会被踢出网络。

blocks.en: There are 4 types of defensive subsystems you may encounter while hacking.
blocks.zh: 破解时可能遇到 4 种防御子系统：

blocks.en: Firewalls, which have high coherence but low strength
blocks.zh: 防火墙（Firewall），连贯性高但强度低；

blocks.en: Anti-Virus, which have low coherence but high strength.
blocks.zh: 反病毒（Anti-Virus），连贯性低但强度高；

blocks.en: Restoration nodes, which 'heal' random defensive subsystems on the network each turn.
blocks.zh: 修复节点（Restoration Node），每回合随机「治疗」网络中的防御子系统；

blocks.en: And Virus suppressors, which weaken your strength while active.
blocks.zh: 以及病毒抑制器（Virus Suppressor），激活时会削弱你的强度。

blocks.en: You generally want to avoid attacking as much as possible
blocks.zh: 一般来说，在它们被清除出网络之前，

blocks.en: until these have been removed from the network.
blocks.zh: 你应该尽量避免发起攻击。

blocks.en: It is generally a good idea to explore further
blocks.zh: 通常比较好的做法是，

blocks.en: before directly attacking a defensive subsystem,
blocks.zh: 在直接攻击防御子系统前先多探索一下，

blocks.en: as you may uncover additional helpful utility subsystems which you can use to overcome them,
blocks.zh: 因为你可能会发现更多有用的辅助子系统来对付它们，

blocks.en: or even the exposed core, if you're lucky.
blocks.zh: 运气好的话，甚至会直接找到暴露的核心。

blocks.en: However, due to the disruptive effects of Restoration and Suppressor nodes,
blocks.zh: 不过，由于修复节点和抑制器节点的干扰效果，

blocks.en: you will want to destroy these immediately.
blocks.zh: 你最好立刻摧毁它们。

blocks.en: The difficulty of a hacking site is generally determined
blocks.zh: 破解站点的难度通常

blocks.en: by the security status of the space you are in.
blocks.zh: 取决于你所在空间的安全等级。

blocks.en: More difficult hacking sites require better equipment, skills and execution,
blocks.zh: 越难的破解站点需要越好的装备、技能和操作，

blocks.en: but can be much more lucrative.
blocks.zh: 但收益也高得多。

blocks.en: In harder sites, defensive nodes will take and deal more coherence damage
blocks.zh: 在较难的站点中，防御节点在被清除前

blocks.en: before being removed.
blocks.zh: 能承受和造成的连贯性伤害都更高。

blocks.en: The dangerous Restoration and Suppressor subsystems
blocks.zh: 危险的修复和抑制器子系统

blocks.en: are also only found in more difficult sites,
blocks.zh: 也只会出现在较难的站点里，

blocks.en: so you don't need to worry about them just yet
blocks.zh: 所以如果你刚开始在高安探索，

blocks.en: if you're starting off exploring in high security space.
blocks.zh: 暂时还不用担心它们。

blocks.en: As you explore a network, you may also discover helpful Utility Subsystems along the way.
blocks.zh: 探索网络时，你可能还会一路发现有用的辅助子系统。

blocks.en: These are tools you can use to gain an advantage
blocks.zh: 这些工具能帮你在对付防御子系统时

blocks.en: in overcoming defensive subsystems and increase your odds of success.
blocks.zh: 获得优势，提高成功几率。

blocks.en: The utility subsystems you may encounter are:
blocks.zh: 你可能遇到的辅助子系统有：

blocks.en: Self Repair, which gradually increases your coherence over each turn.
blocks.zh: 自我修复（Self Repair），每回合逐渐提升你的连贯性。

blocks.en: You'll want to use these immediately, as there is no maximum coherence value.
blocks.zh: 最好立即使用，因为连贯性没有上限。

blocks.en: Kernel rots which cut system's coherence in half.
blocks.zh: 内核腐蚀（Kernel Rot），能将系统的连贯性减半。

blocks.en: Use these to break through high coherence systems such as Firewalls.
blocks.zh: 用它来突破防火墙这类高连贯性的系统。

blocks.en: Polymorphic Shields which nullify the next 2 attacks against you,
blocks.zh: 多态护盾（Polymorphic Shield），能抵消接下来针对你的 2 次攻击，

blocks.en: preventing you from losing coherence.
blocks.zh: 让你不损失连贯性。

blocks.en: Use this before attacking high strength systems, such as an Antivirus.
blocks.zh: 在攻击反病毒这类高强度系统前使用。

blocks.en: And secondary vectors, which reduce a system's coherence over time.
blocks.zh: 还有次级载体（Secondary Vector），能持续削减系统的连贯性。

blocks.en: You'll want to use these to augment attacks against key targets,
blocks.zh: 用它来辅助攻击关键目标，

blocks.en: particularly to wear down suppressor nodes while your virus strength is reduced,
blocks.zh: 尤其是在你的病毒强度被削弱时消耗抑制器节点，

blocks.en: without having to attack them directly.
blocks.zh: 而不必直接攻击它们。

blocks.en: As you explore, you may also uncover Data Caches.
blocks.zh: 探索过程中，你还可能发现数据缓存（Data Cache）。

blocks.en: These may either contain a helpful Utility Subsystem or a dangerous Defensive one.
blocks.zh: 里面可能是有用的辅助子系统，也可能是危险的防御子系统。

blocks.en: Because there is no way to know what a data cache contains before opening it,
blocks.zh: 由于打开之前无法得知数据缓存里装的是什么，

blocks.en: it's generally recommended to only open these as a last resort
blocks.zh: 一般建议只在万不得已时才打开，

blocks.en: when you might otherwise fail without a utility subsystem to give you a needed edge.
blocks.zh: 也就是没有辅助子系统帮你一把就可能失败的时候。

blocks.en: You now know the basics of the hacking process.
blocks.zh: 现在你已经了解了破解流程的基础。

blocks.en: Click through the network, revealing nodes as you go
blocks.zh: 在网络中逐个点击，边走边揭示节点，

blocks.en: and try to find and destroy the System Core,
blocks.zh: 努力找到并摧毁系统核心，

blocks.en: without letting the defensive subsystems destroy you first.
blocks.zh: 别让防御子系统先把你干掉。

blocks.en: Here, you can see we are exploring the network, and find that we've hit a firewall.
blocks.zh: 这里可以看到我们正在探索网络，结果碰到了一道防火墙。

blocks.en: We continue exploring before attacking it, finding a repair which we can use immediately
blocks.zh: 我们先不攻击它，继续探索，找到了一个可以立即使用的修复，

blocks.en: to gain extra coherence.
blocks.zh: 获得了额外的连贯性。

blocks.en: Then, once other routes have turned up empty, we attack the firewall,
blocks.zh: 然后，在其他路线都一无所获后，我们攻击防火墙，

blocks.en: overcoming it and revealing the system core behind it.
blocks.zh: 攻破了它，并揭示出后面的系统核心。

blocks.en: We attack the system core and voila!
blocks.zh: 我们攻击系统核心，大功告成！

blocks.en: We've beaten the hack and can now access the container for the valuable loot within.
blocks.zh: 我们完成了破解，现在可以打开容器拿走里面的战利品了。

blocks.en: While exploring, you will notice a number appear briefly as you reveal a node.
blocks.zh: 探索时你会注意到，揭示节点时会短暂出现一个数字。

blocks.en: This number indicates the distance to the nearest System Core,
blocks.zh: 这个数字表示到最近的系统核心、

blocks.en: Utility Subsystem or Data Cache.
blocks.zh: 辅助子系统或数据缓存的距离。

blocks.en: You can use these to guide you in a potentially useful direction
blocks.zh: 你可以借助这些数字，在探索网络时

blocks.en: as you explore the network.
blocks.zh: 朝可能有收获的方向前进。

blocks.en: For example, we can see that this 5 indicates that the core won't be found
blocks.zh: 例如，这里的 5 表示核心

blocks.en: within 5 nodes of this one,
blocks.zh: 不在距此节点 5 格以内，

blocks.en: so we should probably continue exploring over to another area of the board.
blocks.zh: 所以我们大概应该去棋盘的另一片区域继续探索。

blocks.en: Here, we can see that we have a 1,
blocks.zh: 这里我们看到一个 1，

blocks.en: which indicates there is something potentially interesting nearby.
blocks.zh: 说明附近可能有值得关注的东西。

blocks.en: By exploring the surrounding nodes, we find the System Core,
blocks.zh: 探索周围的节点后，我们找到了系统核心，

blocks.en: which we can then successfully destroy and beat the hack.
blocks.zh: 随后成功摧毁它，完成了破解。

blocks.en: For an extra edge, there is a more advanced technique you can practice while hacking,
blocks.zh: 想更进一步的话，还有一种破解时可以练习的进阶技巧，

blocks.en: which is referred to as the Rule of 6.
blocks.zh: 称为「6 法则（Rule of 6）」。

blocks.en: The rule of 6 simply states that if a node is surrounded by 6 connecting nodes,
blocks.zh: 6 法则很简单：如果一个节点周围连着 6 个节点，

blocks.en: then it either contains no defensive subsystem or is adjacent to the system core.
blocks.zh: 那么它要么没有防御子系统，要么紧邻系统核心。

blocks.en: This means that if you aim for these central nodes,
blocks.zh: 也就是说，如果你优先选择这些中心节点，

blocks.en: you are less likely to encounter defensive subsystems and, if you do,
blocks.zh: 遇到防御子系统的可能性就更小，即使遇到了，

blocks.en: you know that the core is nearby so you don't waste too much time
blocks.zh: 你也知道核心就在附近，不会浪费太多时间

blocks.en: fighting with unnecessary defensive subsystems elsewhere.
blocks.zh: 在别处和不必要的防御子系统纠缠。

blocks.en: Trying to reveal these nodes first is a good tactic to improve your chances of a successful hack.
blocks.zh: 优先揭示这些节点，是提高破解成功率的好策略。

blocks.en: The loot contained within relic and data containers can be sold on the market
blocks.zh: 遗迹和数据容器里的战利品可以在市场上出售，

blocks.en: for a profit which you can then use to upgrade your ship and equipment.
blocks.zh: 赚来的钱可以用来升级舰船和装备。

blocks.en: The loot from relic and data sites is always in demand
blocks.zh: 遗迹和数据站点的战利品

blocks.en: from industrialists who are trying to use it.
blocks.zh: 总是很受需要它们的工业玩家欢迎。

blocks.en: The loot from relic sites is salvage, used in the production of ship rigs
blocks.zh: 遗迹站点的战利品是打捞材料，用于生产舰船改装件，

blocks.en: and the loot from datasites is generally used for the purposes of inventing T2 blueprints.
blocks.zh: 数据站点的战利品则通常用于发明 T2 蓝图。

blocks.en: Now that you understand the basics of hacking,
blocks.zh: 现在你已经了解了破解的基础，

blocks.en: go out there, break open some relic and data containers
blocks.zh: 出发吧，去撬开遗迹和数据容器，

blocks.en: and start filling your cargo with the sweet loot found within.
blocks.zh: 把里面的丰厚战利品装满你的货舱。
